rca_of_issue: Root cause analysis: The calculate-order rate limiter uses the same rate limit bucket as create-order ('Too many payment attempts'), which is too restrictive for a preview endpoint. The calculate-order endpoint is designed for real-time fee preview (called on each ticket quantity change) and should have a much higher rate limit than the actual payment creation endpoint. Suggested fix: Apply a separate, more permissive rate limit key for calculate-order (e.g., 30 req/min) vs create-order (e.g., 5 req/15min).
